supporting_quote: keep showing pop-up box requesting password

discovered_theme: Filters forwarding messages hit server 'too many sessions' SMTP rate limit
root_cause_hypothesis: Filters run concurrently over matched messages and each forward opens a new SMTP session, exceeding provider (verio/CloudFilter) rate limits; FiltaQuilla run-program actions also execute in parallel.
supporting_quote: I'm getting "Too many simultaneous connections on the server". I'd like to limit the concurrency

discovered_theme: Mail disappears from webmail when second PC uses POP account
root_cause_hypothesis: Home client configured as POP3 with 'delete from server', removing messages from the webmail store; IMAP is needed for multi-device use.
supporting_quote: when I open Thunderbird at home, all my email lost in web mail

discovered_theme: Send button does nothing, cannot send messages
root_cause_hypothesis: Toolbar button state/customization glitch or silently failing SMTP send path in the compose window.
supporting_quote: When I press the send icon in The Messaging Company email nothing happens.

discovered_theme: Guidance on folder organization and message-count limits per folder
root_cause_hypothesis: No technical fault; user seeking best-practice guidance on mbox folder sizing and archiving.
supporting_quote: Are there any practical limitations regarding the no. of messages in one folder?

discovered_theme: Gmail authentication failure after 153.0.1 update, cannot download mail
root_cause_hypothesis: Account is using password/app-password instead of OAuth2, and OAuth login window fails without cookies/JavaScript enabled for Google domains.
supporting_quote: non riesco più a scarica e quin di a leggere al posta del mio account gmail

discovered_theme: Yahoo POP connection timeout, no mail downloaded
root_cause_hypothesis: Yahoo POP server requires OAuth/app password or the port/SSL settings are stale, causing connection timeouts.
supporting_quote: "Connessione al server pop.mail.yahoo.com fuori tempo massimo."

discovered_theme: Address book export/import between installations
root_cause_hypothesis: Contacts live in abook.sqlite/history.sqlite which must be copied manually; the documented import path is unclear to users.
supporting_quote: Thought it would be simple to just export my Thunderbird address files from my Windows laptop and import it

discovered_theme: Cannot delete Local Folders account (Delete option greyed out)
root_cause_hypothesis: Local Folders is a built-in pseudo-account that cannot be removed, but UI gives no explanation for the disabled Delete option.
supporting_quote: The choise "Delet" is "shaded", and not active.

discovered_theme: Quick Filter severe slowdown after update
root_cause_hypothesis: Likely an add-on or profile-related regression affecting Quick Filter view rebuilding, since troubleshooting mode is fast.
supporting_quote: da qualche tempo riscontro un forte rallentamento su filtro veloce

discovered_theme: Repeated password prompt actually from iCloud CalDAV calendar
root_cause_hypothesis: iCloud CalDAV subscription requires an app-specific password, and the prompt is misattributed by the user to email login.
supporting_quote: Every time I open my e mail it wants a user name and password. EVERY TIME

discovered_theme: POP mail lost after PC failure; profile recovery and import failure
root_cause_hypothesis: POP messages stored only in old local profile; Import tool fails and mbox files must be imported manually via ImportExportTools NG.
supporting_quote: Import failed unexpectedly, more information may be available in the error console.

discovered_theme: Printed emails include full header/routing info
root_cause_hypothesis: View > Headers was set to All, causing full headers in print/PDF output; menu bar hidden making the setting hard to find.
supporting_quote: Printing emails includes pages of email routing info.

discovered_theme: Sent folder shows display name instead of actual recipient address for shared addresses
root_cause_hypothesis: 'Show only display name for people in my address book' overrides the actual address shown in the message list/TO line.
supporting_quote: having problem with more than one contact having same email address

discovered_theme: Compose from desktop shortcut also opens main window (regression in 153)
root_cause_hypothesis: Change since 140.x forces full app window load before compose to fix background-startup bugs.
supporting_quote: Just want to open a 'compose a message' without the extra main window also opening.

discovered_theme: User-created folders missing from folder pane after update
root_cause_hypothesis: Folder pane view mode changes after upgrade hide subfolders; dragging folders in compact view detached messages, causing apparent data loss.
supporting_quote: Thunderbird just updated and the next time I opened it all of the folders I created and the emails I'm storing within them are missing.

discovered_theme: Profile zip Import fails with NS_ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND / restored profile not loading
root_cause_hypothesis: ThunderbirdProfileImporter aborts on a missing file during recursive local folder copy, and the manually copied profile isn't recognized/registered properly.
supporting_quote: About 19% in, I received error "Import failed unexpectedly, more information may be available in the Error Console."

discovered_theme: Yahoo/Comcast OAuth login loop repeatedly prompting for password on one machine
root_cause_hypothesis: Yahoo's OAuth flow in TB 153 fails without mailnews.oauth.usePrivateBrowser=true, so the token is never stored and Thunderbird re-prompts for a password.
supporting_quote: I keep getting a request for a new password, over and over

discovered_theme: Flood of Mailer-Daemon bounce messages from spoofed address
root_cause_hypothesis: Third party is spoofing the user's address for spam, so backscatter bounces arrive; server-side/provider issue, not Thunderbird.
supporting_quote: I am getting hundreds of emails a day from the following:  Mailer-Daemon@gator3303.hostgator.com

discovered_theme: Mail from one account appearing in another account's inbox
root_cause_hypothesis: Two accounts likely share the same local message storage directory, or the user is viewing Unified Folders.
supporting_quote: Why does one accounts email end up in another accounts inbox

discovered_theme: Calendar migration fails: ICS import errors and cal_id mismatch in local.sqlite
root_cause_hypothesis: Calendar UUIDs in prefs.js don't match those in a copied local.sqlite, so events are orphaned; ICS import also errors on missing fields.
supporting_quote: the database cal_id fields did not match between my new system and the old one

discovered_theme: Accounts listed twice in Unified Folders
root_cause_hypothesis: Stale smart-mailboxes profile data or duplicate special folder assignments (e.g. Draft vs Drafts) cause duplicated entries.
supporting_quote: my accounts are showing twice in some of the unified folders

discovered_theme: Accounts listed twice in Unified Folders (duplicate post)
root_cause_hypothesis: Same as the original report: stale smart-mailboxes cache duplicating account entries.
supporting_quote: For some reason my accounts are showing twice in some of the unified folders.

discovered_theme: Messages inconsistently auto-marked as read or stuck unread after Windows 11 move
root_cause_hypothesis: Mark-as-read preference/IMAP flag sync is inconsistent, possibly corrupted .msf indexes or conflicting per-folder read settings after profile migration.
supporting_quote: A new message arrives and instantly changes to read (not bolded) on arrival even if I have not viewed the message

discovered_theme: Sent messages not saved/visible anywhere after 153 update
root_cause_hypothesis: Corrupted .msf index files or the 'place reply in folder of original' copy setting misbehaving after upgrade to 153.
supporting_quote: Since this morning, the sent messages don't appear anywhere.

discovered_theme: Stored account passwords no longer work after long period of disuse
root_cause_hypothesis: Expired OAuth token or provider-side password/app-password change since last use requires re-authentication.
supporting_quote: After not using my thunderbird email in over a year, my login passwords are not working.

discovered_theme: Junk folder renamed to Spam producing two identical 'Spam' folders
root_cause_hypothesis: mail.useLocalizedFolderNames localizes Junk as 'Spam', duplicating the server-side Spam folder name in the folder pane.
supporting_quote: A few days ago the left (file) pane went from - InBox - Drafts - Sent - Junk - Spam - Trash to - InBox - Drafts - Sent - Spam - Spam - Trash

discovered_theme: How to add a new email account
root_cause_hypothesis: User unfamiliar with account setup UI location; no technical defect.
supporting_quote: How can I add a new e-mail account?
